R6T-duck-drive-0001.pressureWhy: Busier: within 1 km of a paved road (estimate).

evidence.t: Unnamed wetland, 10.7 ha, 40 m from the road.
About 13 wetlands within 2 km (estimate): ducks move between them.
Beside Tutshi River: backwater or oxbow (estimate).
Elevation 744 m: under 900 m, open water later in fall.

flags.t: Klondike Hwy 40 m N: no hunting or shooting on or across the road allowance of a numbered highway or 2 lane public road, 15 m (16 yd) each side of the centre line (synopsis page 10, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: District 6. Within the 8 a day: 4 northern pintails, 4 canvasbacks, 2 Barrow's or common goldeneyes together, 2 harlequins. Possession 24: 12, 12, 6, 6.

plan: Drive: from Atlin, about 92 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 59.79712, -134.87561, pull off on Klondike Hwy (paved road). Map links below.
Walk: 40 m S, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-27, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-03, closures 2026-10-16.

R6T-grouse-walk-0001.name: 3.4 km SE of Lindeman Lake
R6T-grouse-walk-0001.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R6T-grouse-walk-0001.parkWhat: pull off on Klondike Hwy (paved road)

evidence.t: Trail: Log Cabin Cross-Country Ski Trail, 3.2 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
6 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 6 table (pages 50 and 51), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis).

plan: Drive: from Atlin, about 95 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 59.76551, -134.94411, pull off on Klondike Hwy (paved road). Map links below.
Walk 3.2 km to the start. Walk: the Log Cabin Cross-Country Ski Trail stretch, 3.2 km one way. About 65 min one way at 3 km/h.
